(a) clustering email based on the contents and metadata of emails can be used to infer the user's activities; (b) the performance of clustering email can be improved by using a variety of information extraction and pretrained classification techniques, and (c) the performance of email clustering is strongly dependent on the user's email habits, and the performance is best when the email clusters are small and focused on a particular activity
